evidence: EXEC CICS GET CONTAINER / PUT CONTAINER

purpose.domain_detail: CICS TS sample/example application — Phone Book with DB2 backend and z/OS Connect API integration
purpose.summary: PBOOKDB2 is the controller module for a CICS Phone Book sample application. It receives commands via a CICS channel/container (JSONCHANNEL), dispatches to DB2 CRUD operations (SELECT, UPDATE, DELETE, INSERT) on a CONTACTS table, and on delete also calls an external REST API via the z/OS Connect BAQ Host API Requester. Results are returned in output containers.

notable_features: EXEC CICS GET/PUT CONTAINER with named channel (JSONCHANNEL)
z/OS Connect BAQ Host API Requester (BAQHAREC, BAQHCONC, BAQINIT, BAQEXEC)
COPY copybooks: PBOOKCIN, PBOOKCO1, PBOOKCO2, BAQHAREC, BAQHCONC, API00I01, API00Q01, API00P01
EVALUATE on SQLCODE for DB2 error handling
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars; C-PROCESS section is cut off mid-line. Comments contain French text and some encoding artifacts (©, Û) suggesting UTF-8 re-encoding of an EBCDIC source. The program is a well-structured IBM sample/demo but exhibits production-level patterns (error handling, API integration, DB2 CRUD). Hardcoded credentials are a concern but common in sample code.
